items.content_html: LUIS (Local University Information System) is a lightweight AI chatbot built with Node.js, TailwindCSS, and Gemini Pro. It naturally answers college-related questions, like your next class, today’s schedule, or off days, using your local timetable data. Fast, private, and minimal, LUIS feels like your personal academic assistant.
